questions.question: Auto transformer is most economical when the value of K is..........
questions.explanation: The source says an autotransformer is economical when K is near unity. Then it needs less copper for transformation.
explanationLines: The source says an autotransformer is economical when K is near unity.
Then it needs less copper for transformation.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In a transformer operation which quantity remains fixed?
questions.explanation: The source says voltage and current magnitude may change. But frequency remains constant in both circuits.
explanationLines: The source says voltage and current magnitude may change.
But frequency remains constant in both circuits.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The oil used in transformer serve as.........
questions.explanation: Transformer oil helps cooling of the transformer. It also works as an insulating medium.
explanationLines: Transformer oil helps cooling of the transformer.
It also works as an insulating medium.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The test is done to find copper loss in transformer is.............
questions.explanation: The source connects short circuit test with copper loss. Copper loss mainly depends on winding current.
explanationLines: The source connects short circuit test with copper loss.
Copper loss mainly depends on winding current.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which type of core has good mechanical support?
questions.explanation: The source explains shell type gives better mechanical support. Its core surrounds the winding more than core type.
explanationLines: The source explains shell type gives better mechanical support.
Its core surrounds the winding more than core type.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Constant loss in transformer is
questions.explanation: Iron loss is almost constant for a given voltage and frequency. Copper loss changes with load current.
explanationLines: Iron loss is almost constant for a given voltage and frequency.
Copper loss changes with load current.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: For isolation transformer the value of K equals to..........
questions.explanation: In an isolation transformer, voltage ratio is one. So the transformation ratio K is unity.
explanationLines: In an isolation transformer, voltage ratio is one.
So the transformation ratio K is unity.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The test is done to find iron loss in transformer is............
questions.explanation: The source uses open circuit test to find iron loss. At no load, core loss is mainly measured.
explanationLines: The source uses open circuit test to find iron loss.
At no load, core loss is mainly measured.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The test is done to find copper loss in transformer is............
questions.explanation: Short circuit test is used for copper loss in the source. It measures loss due to winding resistance.
explanationLines: Short circuit test is used for copper loss in the source.
It measures loss due to winding resistance.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The function of buchholz relay in transformer is...........
questions.explanation: The source lists Buchholz relay as a power transformer part. Its function in the source exercise is to give alarm signal.
explanationLines: The source lists Buchholz relay as a power transformer part.
Its function in the source exercise is to give alarm signal.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which of following is variable loss in Transformer?
questions.explanation: Copper loss varies with load current in transformer windings. Iron loss is treated as constant loss in the source exercise.
explanationLines: Copper loss varies with load current in transformer windings.
Iron loss is treated as constant loss in the source exercise.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What type of electrical device is a transformer?
questions.explanation: The source calls transformer an AC static electrical device. It has no rotating or movable parts.
explanationLines: The source calls transformer an AC static electrical device.
It has no rotating or movable parts.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What does a transformer transfer from one circuit to another?
questions.explanation: The source says transformer transfers energy between circuits. There is no direct electrical connection between the two circuits.
explanationLines: The source says transformer transfers energy between circuits.
There is no direct electrical connection between the two circuits.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which two main windings are found in a transformer?
questions.explanation: The source names primary winding and secondary winding. They are also called HV and LV windings.
explanationLines: The source names primary winding and secondary winding.
They are also called HV and LV windings.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The two windings of a transformer are electrically ............
questions.explanation: The source says there is no electrical connection between windings. Energy is transferred by electromagnetic induction.
explanationLines: The source says there is no electrical connection between windings.
Energy is transferred by electromagnetic induction.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: A transformer works in which circuit?
questions.explanation: The source states that a transformer works in AC circuits only. It needs changing magnetic flux for operation.
explanationLines: The source states that a transformer works in AC circuits only.
It needs changing magnetic flux for operation.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which law is the transformer energy transfer based on?
questions.explanation: The source says transformer energy is transformed by Faraday's law. Changing flux induces emf in the windings.
explanationLines: The source says transformer energy is transformed by Faraday's law.
Changing flux induces emf in the windings.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which function of transformer is mentioned in the source?
options: To raise or lower AC voltage and current
To convert AC into chemical energy
questions.correctOption: To raise or lower AC voltage and current
questions.explanation: The source says transformer changes voltage and current level. It can step up or step down AC quantities.
explanationLines: The source says transformer changes voltage and current level.
It can step up or step down AC quantities.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: A transformer can isolate two circuits ............
questions.explanation: The source lists electrical isolation as a transformer function. The windings are not directly connected.
explanationLines: The source lists electrical isolation as a transformer function.
The windings are not directly connected.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In a transformer core, windings are placed on the ............
questions.explanation: The source says core has yoke and limb parts. Windings are placed on the limbs of the core.
explanationLines: The source says core has yoke and limb parts.
Windings are placed on the limbs of the core.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Why are transformer cores laminated and thin?
questions.explanation: The source mentions laminated thin core construction. Lamination is used to reduce eddy current loss.
explanationLines: The source mentions laminated thin core construction.
Lamination is used to reduce eddy current loss.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which materials are generally used for transformer core?
questions.explanation: The source says transformer core generally consists of iron or steel. These materials provide a magnetic path for flux.
explanationLines: The source says transformer core generally consists of iron or steel.
These materials provide a magnetic path for flux.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What are the two basic core parts named in the source?
questions.explanation: The source says transformer core has yoke and limb. Windings are placed on the core limbs.
explanationLines: The source says transformer core has yoke and limb.
Windings are placed on the core limbs.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What is the basic working action of a transformer?
questions.explanation: Transformer operation depends on changing flux linking two windings. That is mutual induction between primary and secondary.
explanationLines: Transformer operation depends on changing flux linking two windings.
That is mutual induction between primary and secondary.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: When AC is applied to primary winding, it produces ............
questions.explanation: The source explains AC supply creates alternating flux in the core. This flux links the secondary winding.
explanationLines: The source explains AC supply creates alternating flux in the core.
This flux links the secondary winding.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: The emf equation of transformer is based on maximum flux, frequency and ............
questions.explanation: The source gives emf equation using frequency, flux and turns. More turns give more induced emf.
explanationLines: The source gives emf equation using frequency, flux and turns.
More turns give more induced emf.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What does transformation ratio compare?
options: Primary and secondary voltage or turns
questions.correctOption: Primary and secondary voltage or turns
questions.explanation: The source explains transformation ratio using voltage and turns relation. It shows how the transformer changes voltage level.
explanationLines: The source explains transformation ratio using voltage and turns relation.
It shows how the transformer changes voltage level.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In a step-up transformer, the secondary voltage is ............ primary voltage.
questions.explanation: A step-up transformer raises voltage level. The source describes transformer as raising or lowering AC voltage.
explanationLines: A step-up transformer raises voltage level.
The source describes transformer as raising or lowering AC voltage.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: In a step-down transformer, the secondary voltage is ............ primary voltage.
questions.explanation: A step-down transformer lowers voltage level. This is one function of transformer given in the source.
explanationLines: A step-down transformer lowers voltage level.
This is one function of transformer given in the source.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What condition is called no-load condition of transformer?
questions.explanation: In no-load operation, load is not connected to secondary. The source explains transformer operation on no-load condition.
explanationLines: In no-load operation, load is not connected to secondary.
The source explains transformer operation on no-load condition.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: What is load condition of transformer?
questions.explanation: When a load is connected, secondary current flows. The source discusses transformer on load condition.
explanationLines: When a load is connected, secondary current flows.
The source discusses transformer on load condition.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Copper loss in a transformer occurs mainly in ............
questions.explanation: Copper loss is due to current in transformer windings. It depends on winding resistance and load current.
explanationLines: Copper loss is due to current in transformer windings.
It depends on winding resistance and load current.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Iron loss in transformer is made up mainly of ............
questions.explanation: The source lists hysteresis loss and eddy current loss under iron loss. These losses occur in the core.
explanationLines: The source lists hysteresis loss and eddy current loss under iron loss.
These losses occur in the core.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which loss changes with load in transformer?
questions.explanation: Copper loss depends on load current. So it changes when load current changes.
explanationLines: Copper loss depends on load current.
So it changes when load current changes.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which test is performed with one winding open?
questions.explanation: The source names open circuit test for transformer. It is used to determine iron loss.
explanationLines: The source names open circuit test for transformer.
It is used to determine iron loss.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Which test is performed with one winding shorted safely?
questions.explanation: The source names short circuit test for transformer. It is used to find copper loss.
explanationLines: The source names short circuit test for transformer.
It is used to find copper loss.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Three phase transformer construction may use ............
questions.explanation: The source discusses single unit three phase transformer. It also compares with three units of single phase transformers.
explanationLines: The source discusses single unit three phase transformer.
It also compares with three units of single phase transformers.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: One advantage of three units of single phase transformers is ............
questions.explanation: The source lists easier transportation as an advantage. Separate units are easier to handle than one large unit.
explanationLines: The source lists easier transportation as an advantage.
Separate units are easier to handle than one large unit.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Another advantage of three single phase transformer units is ............
questions.explanation: The source says three units can give better reliability of supply. One unit problem may not stop all operation in the same way.
explanationLines: The source says three units can give better reliability of supply.
One unit problem may not stop all operation in the same way.

questions.question: Which is a part of a power transformer?
questions.explanation: The source lists conservator tank as a power transformer part. Other listed parts include tank, breather and Buchholz relay.
explanationLines: The source lists conservator tank as a power transformer part.
Other listed parts include tank, breather and Buchholz relay.

questions.question: Which part absorbs moisture in transformer breathing system?
questions.explanation: The source lists breather as a power transformer part. Its role is linked with moisture control in transformer air path.
explanationLines: The source lists breather as a power transformer part.
Its role is linked with moisture control in transformer air path.

questions.question: Which power transformer part provides external connection through insulation?
questions.explanation: The source lists bushing among power transformer parts. Bushing carries conductor through transformer tank insulation.
explanationLines: The source lists bushing among power transformer parts.
Bushing carries conductor through transformer tank insulation.

questions.question: Which transformer part changes voltage tapping?
questions.explanation: The source lists tap changer as a transformer part. It is used for selecting winding taps.
explanationLines: The source lists tap changer as a transformer part.
It is used for selecting winding taps.

questions.question: Parallel operation of transformers needs same ............
questions.explanation: The source discusses necessary conditions for parallel operation. Same voltage ratio helps avoid circulating current.
explanationLines: The source discusses necessary conditions for parallel operation.
Same voltage ratio helps avoid circulating current.
questions.subject: electrical-machine

questions.question: Another requirement for parallel transformer operation is same ............
questions.explanation: The source includes polarity among parallel operation conditions. Wrong polarity can cause wrong voltage connection.
explanationLines: The source includes polarity among parallel operation conditions.
Wrong polarity can cause wrong voltage connection.

questions.question: Auto transformer has which special feature?
options: common winding part for primary and secondary
questions.correctOption: common winding part for primary and secondary
questions.explanation: The source explains auto transformer as having a common winding part. So it is different from a two-winding transformer.
explanationLines: The source explains auto transformer as having a common winding part.
So it is different from a two-winding transformer.

questions.question: Which is an application of auto transformer in the source?
questions.explanation: The source lists applications of auto transformer. One use is for voltage control during motor starting.
explanationLines: The source lists applications of auto transformer.
One use is for voltage control during motor starting.

questions.question: Cooling of transformer is needed because losses produce ............
questions.explanation: The source discusses transformer losses and cooling. Losses raise temperature, so cooling is required.
explanationLines: The source discusses transformer losses and cooling.
Losses raise temperature, so cooling is required.

questions.question: Which cooling medium is commonly used in oil-immersed transformer?
questions.explanation: The source says transformer oil serves as coolant. It also acts as an insulator in transformer.
explanationLines: The source says transformer oil serves as coolant.
It also acts as an insulator in transformer.

questions.question: Which transformer system needs more connections and wiring according to the source?
options: three units of single phase transformers
questions.correctOption: three units of single phase transformers
